name: cal_63_air_bat_v3
notes:
Battery-supply epoch v3, re-swept.
Threshold 3 changed 4.70 -> 4.75 V: the 4.70 column started showing problems after ~30 minutes
in classviz. Locked 2026-07-26, fw v4.26, 6S 16650 pack at 23.5 -> 23.35 V across the sweep
(thermal soak time at lock, and the originating cal-run stamp for this re-sweep, not recorded).
Supersedes cal_63_air_v2. Band plan unchanged and verified band for band - 7 bands 9 -> 100 us,
7 x 9 = 63 cells. The threshold ladder is NOT unchanged: it moves in one position,
4.9 / 4.8 / 4.75 / 4.4 / 4.2 / 3.8 / 2.4 / 1.5 / 0.5 V against v2's 4.70 in third place.
Of the 4.75/4.35/3.70 ladder trialled 2026-07-24 only the 4.75 step is adopted; 4.40 and 3.80
are kept at their original values, having come back clean under battery power - that trial's
4.40/3.80 elevation was supply-borne, this 4.75 move is a separate and later observation.
Delays re-anchored for the supply change: +40 to +144 ns against v2, band means +90 ns (100 us)
to +125 ns (30 us). The third column is the outlier at +40 to +72 ns and is NOT a like-for-like
delta - that cell targets a different voltage, so its shift is threshold move plus supply change
and the two are not separated here.
Sweep parameters: fine step 40 ns, averages 32; Auto Nudge threshold 0.3 mV, step 8 ns, soak 40 s,
std dev N = 16. Convergence at 0.3 mV was never achievable under the bench PSU (0.5 mV was the
working value); under 6S it converged with one cell of 63 needing a single -8 ns nudge.
Thermal criterion replacing the removed TX-resistor thermistor check: converged when successive
calibrations differ by no more than one 8 ns grid step, watching the 100 us band - at lock,
+/-8 ns in 6 of 63 cells, all others zero.
Corpus rule: a new calibration epoch AND a threshold-geometry change. Cell count matches
cal_63_air_v1/v2, but delays differ throughout and the third column samples a different voltage,
so that column is not comparable across the epoch boundary even feature-wise (DESIGN 13).
Never mix frames across epochs.
